newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain sees inflation below 3 pct in H1 97.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain sees inflation below 3 pct in H1 97.

text.p: Bank of Spain Deputy Governor Miguel Martin said on Thursday that it was likely Spanish inflation would fall beneath three percent in the first half of the year.
"It is highly probable that Spanish inflation will fall below three percent in the first half of this year," Martin said at an economic seminar.
The Spanish inflation rate fell to 3.2 percent in December, beneath the government's mid-year target of 3.4 percent, and the lowest level in almost 30 years.

Earlier this month, Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro told Reuters consumer inflation would fall beneath three percent in the first quarter and the government would meet its 1997 price goal --to end the year at 2.6 percent-- comfortably.
